name: zerog-deps
description: Static dependency sysroot for the ZeroG port (ZeroG.md, 'Dipendenze'). Every library is static and built with the pinned toolchain; features are trimmed to what WebCore uses.

dependencies.name: openssl
dependencies.$comment: BoringSSL, through the overlay in deps/ports/openssl

dependencies.name: egl-registry
dependencies.$comment: Khronos EGL headers only; the driver is loaded at run time

dependencies.name: sdl3
dependencies.$comment: Window mode (ZeroG.md, 'Modalità finestra'): window, events, input. X11 and Wayland are loaded at run time; IBus (D-Bus) comes with IME support.

dependencies.name: curl
dependencies.$comment: HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 over BoringSSL; brotli/zstd decoding; WebSocket for dev-mode hot reload. Cookies and the PSL are handled by WebCore.
